claims.text: The binary classifier used is a Bernoulli Naïve Bayes classifier trained on binary occurrence matrices created from relevant sentences extracted from publications.
The classifier is trained to identify whether publications meet specific criteria based on the relevant sentences identified by the method.
The classifier performs better when trained on candidate sentences than on randomly selected sentences from the text.
